methodology.near_duplicate_similarity: TF-IDF cosine similarity using char_wb character n-grams of lengths 3-5, fitted independently for each dataset.
methodology.near_duplicate_pair_counting: Unique unordered pairs, excluding exact duplicate pairs.
methodology.repeated_sentence_definition: A review counts if it contains any case-insensitive sentence that occurs in another review.
methodology.phrase_counting: Distinct 3-6 word phrases counted once per review.
